# mistershell_automation_playbook (Data Source)

Reads a MisterShell automation_playbook by ID or exact name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mistershell_automation_playbook" "example" {
  id = "123"
}

# Alternatively, resolve one exact name.
data "mistershell_automation_playbook" "by_name" {
  name = "automation-playbook"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Object ID. Specify either ID or an exact name; resource variables use resource_id:stack_id.
- `name` (String) Name.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Created at.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enabled.
- `graph` (Dynamic, Sensitive) Graph.
- `last_run_at` (String) Last run at.
- `last_run_status` (String) Last run status.
- `run_count` (Number) Run count.
- `trigger_event_name` (String) Trigger event name.
- `trigger_filters` (Dynamic) Trigger filters.
- `updated_at` (String) Updated at.
